title: Implement two independent JavaScript modules in this project and
objective:
Implement two independent JavaScript modules in this project and deliver a verified, reviewable result. Create numbers.mjs exporting sumIntegers(input): sum comma-separated signed safe integers, trim token whitespace, reject empty input/tokens, fractions, nonnumbers and unsafe integers, and reject unsafe sums. Create text.mjs exporting normalizeWhitespace(input): trim/collapse Unicode whitespace to one ASCII space, preserve letter case and non-ASCII letters. The original tests under tests/ are the contracts; do not weaken or alter those assertions. Split the two modules into independent parallel branches so actual executions overlap; a dependent integration/documentation task must consume both checked artifacts and write README.md with examples. For each branch run the applicable npm tests; the missing sibling contract TODO is intentional only before handoff. Final delivery must contain both modules, README.md, all original contracts passing with zero TODO/skipped tests, and actual combined npm test evidence. Use the configured ACP harness and available BRO model route. Work only in assigned isolated workspaces, use Node/npm built-ins, do not install dependencies, use Python, access credentials, merge or deploy. Preserve this source project; deliver the combined patch/workspace for review. Human acceptance is not required.

Harness selection for this separate acceptance attempt: use the configured opencode-live ACP harness for all executable branches. The original Codex attempt remains paused with an unmapped legacy dispatch and a stateless native-reasoning replay refusal; it is not replayed or counted as completed. Keep every original condition above, including the original tests and zero TODO/skips. Use optional BRO model-route control only if actually negotiated; opencode-live already has a configured actual BRO/OpenRouter model.
